{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders after cleaning:", qa_mask.sum())

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_sales = sales[~qa_mask & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check final number of rows
print("Final number of rows:", len(filtered_sales))

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = filtered_sales.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()
print("Channel revenue (cleaned, filtered):")
print(channel_revenue.to_string(index=False))

# Find which channel has the most revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue_clean'].idxmax()]['channel']
print("Channel with most revenue:", max_channel)"}
